messages:
alex_sales: Quick ask — ACME wants a 6-month dedicated commit (4 x A100-equivalent) for a POC. Theyre requesting a _30-day_ complimentary burst carveout for onboarding (2x burst for up to 8 GPUs). Need deal-desk guidance and a pricing exception path. What do we need to greenlight this?
maria_se: POC details: ~1k requests/day, ~512 token avg, want autoscale up to 8 GPUs during peak. KV cache heavy in test. Burst needed for first 30 days to ramp.
jordan_finance: FYI standard: commit -> reserved pool pricing. Burst billed as a multiplier (our ratecard currently uses 2.5x base GPU hourly). We can consider a limited promo but need ARR math + approval from revenue lead.
alex_sales: Rough numbers to discuss (back-of-envelope):
``
base A100 list: $3.20/hr
commit discounted (40%): $1.92/hr per GPU
normal burst charge (2.5x): $4.80/hr
proposal: first 30 days, allow 2x burst free capped at 8 GPUs and 200k tokens/day
```
jordan_finance: Need a deal-desk ticket with total committed spend, expected uplift, and risk to margin. I can greenlight a 2-week complimentary burst promo, but 30 days needs exec sign-off and a signed MSA.
alex_sales: Understood. They will sign an MSA if we can make the onboarding terms reasonable. I'll collect the security questionnaire answers and SSO/VPC details.
sam_enginfra: Technical constraints: autoscale policy must cap burst to not exceed 8 GPUs sustained >6 hours/day. If they want >8 sustained we need to reserve capacity (affects pricing). Also need model quantization profile to confirm throughput.
rita_legal: Quick legal/security flag — does the POC include customer data? If yes we require VPC or private deployment + KMS + audit logs. For hosted with redacted data we might be OK, but need completed vendor security questionnaire before private access. If they insist on 30d free burst, we'll require a SOC2 addendum.
alex_sales: I'll gather SQ and external contacts. @jordan_finance can you open the deal-desk ticket? I'll add ARR and the POC runbook link. @maria_se will document the autoscale policy.
jordan_finance: Created ticket DD-20260314-87: requesting 30-day complimentary 2x burst capped at 8 GPUs / 200k token limit. Routing to revenue lead for exec sign-off. Tentative approval for a 14-day promo from finance.
maria_se: POC runbook (internal): https://redwood-internal/pocs/acme-onboard — steps: 1) sign MSA; 2) enable VPC peering; 3) configure KMS; 4) define prompts + token quotas; 5) test autoscale caps.
rita_legal: :thumbsup: Will review MSA redlines and security answers tonight. If they want 30 days we need SOC2 addendum + SLA addendum.
jordan_finance: Revenue lead (cc'd in ticket) has to OK the 30d. For now finance confirms a 14-day complimentary burst is approved pending signed MSA & security QA.
alex_sales: Thanks all — we'll propose a 14-day complimentary burst in the quote with clear caps and a path to extend after exec approval. Will update the ticket and loop in the customer.
